display_title: The Lady Is Possessed by the Demon of Lust
description:
*“Serena… seems to be possessed by a demon.”* 

Nathaniel, a priest of lowly birth. After returning to his hometown, the Earldom of Graves, after ten years, he found that Serena, the young lady he had served, was possessed by a demon. Unable to resist the earl’s pressure, he went to check on Serena’s condition…

 *“Ah, ahh… ugh.”*

Serena moaned strangely and slowly kneaded her ample breasts.

 *“Ugh, hah, Nate.”*

A very low-level demon had possessed his former master who had been treated so badly. The demon of lust.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
